title: Computer vision / pattern recognition applied to ESG and finance
description: Retrieval pack for a review on vision-based methods used on ESG, sustainability and financial documents. No human-labelled gold set yet, so this pack is retrieval-only: it can search but must not claim coverage.

slots.note: The application side. Every candidate must be about money, disclosure or sustainability — not vision in general.
Deliberately visual-only. First draft used 'pattern recognition' and 'remote sensing', which matched any ML paper and any report mentioning satellites; the pool was mostly non-vision work.

dimensions.note: Text+layout of reports; the vision contribution is usually document parsing.
Remote sensing for environmental metrics; the finance link is the asset or portfolio being measured.
Financial charts in reports; a genuinely different reading task from tables.
Often tabular, not visual. Expect low vision yield — that is information, not a failure.

extraQueries.why: The bare acronym ESG collides with unrelated uses and the phrase 'ESG' alone is not a topic; paired with one finance noun it is.
extraQueries.query: ("ESG" AND (report OR rating OR disclosure)) AND ("computer vision" OR "pattern recognition" OR OCR OR "document understanding")

output.scopeDirective: No gold set: report pool sizes and per-axis yield only. Do not compute coverage, precision or any percentage.
